source: FPMarketsSC-Demo XAUUSD.r completed M1 bid OHLC with reported per-bar spread; no other feed pooled
primary_hypothesis: Direction of the final completed Friday M1 candle predicts same-direction Monday continuation; primary outcome is first +$5/+10/+20 versus equivalent adverse move in first four hours after immediate reopen. Later entry methods and every other Friday definition are secondary.
weekend_pair: Last Friday M1 to first following Monday M1, 40-80 elapsed hours; require at least 40 Friday M1, 10 prior full trading days for ATR, and complete post-entry horizon for each reported outcome
atr: Mean true range of 14 completed trading days strictly before Friday; Friday and Monday excluded

entries.AFTER_15M: First M1 open at least 15 elapsed minutes after reopen, maximum 2-minute lateness
entries.AFTER_30M: First M1 open at least 30 elapsed minutes after reopen, maximum 2-minute lateness
entries.DIRECTIONAL_H1: First completed 60-minute block after reopen whose bid close-open direction agrees with Friday signal, first 4 hours only; next M1 open
entries.PULLBACK_CONTINUATION: In first 4 hours, first $5 favorable bid displacement, then $2 pullback from favorable extreme, then M1 close $1 beyond that extreme; next M1 open; same-bar sequencing is not inferred
entries.FIRST_RANGE_BREAKOUT: First 30-minute Monday bid range, then M1 close $1 outside the range in Friday direction within first 4 hours; next M1 open

fills: Buy enters at M1 bid open + bar spread, exits at later bid; sell enters at bid open and exits at later bid + bar spread; no slippage/commission or exact tick fill inferred
barrier_window: First four hours after entry; both thresholds in one M1 bar = ambiguous; missing/gapped interval = censored
sessions: London/NY results use Europe/Athens as an unverified broker-server DST proxy; London and NY local Monday close are 16:00 and 17:00, with early broker Tuesday bars included to reach New York close; performance is entry-to-session-close, not intraday session-only P/L
split: Chronological 70% weekends in sample, 30% out of sample; no parameter tuning on either split
confidence: Wilson 95% binomial intervals and deterministic weekend bootstrap 95% intervals for means; descriptive when sample is small
benchmarks: 50/50 Monday buy/sell return on same weekends
